subject: Re: review date
text:
Hi,

I am following up again. The report draft was sent Tuesday. You asked for revisions. I made those changes. Then you moved the review date. I thought we agreed on Friday. I still have lab hours. I need the notes before then. Without notes, I fall behind. This is the issue.

I am not upset. I just want clarity. The timeline felt shifted. You said Monday was better. Then Thursday appeared in the thread. I am trying to plan my week. I cannot redo this work blindly.

Please let me know the fixed time. I will adjust my classes. I will also save a slot for you. If Friday is impossible, choose another day. Please make it before the submission date. I need one working session.

I understand your schedule is full. I also have a deadline. A short confirmation helps. A quick sentence is enough. I do not need a long call. I want a firm date. Then I can proceed.

I am happy to send the file. I can share my current outline. I want this project to finish smoothly.

I respect your input. I also need fair notice. Last minute changes stress me. They waste focus. I have two other assessments. Your delay narrows my time. Please account for that. I am being direct.

I value your guidance. If Friday cannot work, send comments now. I can revise without meeting. That may solve this. I remain flexible. I just need the next step.

Thanks,
A student
